Inworld Text-to-Speech API. Synchronous synthesis (returns base64 audio in one response), server-streamed synthesis (chunked audio for low-latency playback), and WebSocket-based bidirectional streaming synthesis. Backed by the Realtime TTS-2, Realtime TTS 1.5 Max, and Realtime TTS 1.5 Mini models with word- and character-level alignment, phoneme/viseme metadata for lipsync, custom pronunciation, pause controls, voice tags, and long-text input.
